scope: All 285 existing archived definitions; 262 playable after the sole new retirement. Prior full-bank review carried forward and the 20-hole pilot reconsidered using player feedback and combination-level editorial judgement. Recommendations are qualitative risks, not predicted route difficulty.

inventory.reason: HONEST is a broad personal assessment with fewer concrete onward contexts. LIFT and SEASON are individually rich, but their combination may reward generic middle links.
inventory.recommendation: Consider replacing the combination, retaining the individual words.
